summary: Your patience evaporates instantly the moment one more demand lands on top of boundaries you've already let slide.
body: Your patience evaporates instantly the moment one more demand lands on top of boundaries you've already let slide. When the Moon squares Mars, emotional friction and physical urgency collide, making a routine interruption or tiny request carry the weight of everything you've been quietly swallowing. The anger is telling you the truth about your depletion, but it's a terrible guide for who to blame. Acknowledge where you're running on fumes before you make the nearest bystander pay for the whole backlog.
